registration: Frozen after source-only refinement and before this runner's implementation or any individual velocity comparison. Public summary Vflat and its error were accidentally displayed during metadata extraction; the full response container was already exposed historically and parsed again for schema. Development only, no claim of response-blind or untouched confirmation.
source_sensitivity_rule: One source variation at a time, all candidates on every variation, no best-nuisance selection. Stellar +/-0.1 dex follows the fixed-M/L paper's approximate systematic scale; gas +/-10% and +/-30%, doubled/halved heights and aperture alternatives are declared stress tests, not measured confidence intervals. Fine/coarse field gates apply to every variant; the pre-existing 1024/2048 map comparison and extended-boundary check apply to primary only. Variation-specific map and boundary covariance remain unresolved.

geometry.primary_velocity_conversion: v_model_geometry=v_published*sin(i_published)/sin(i_photometric); same multiplier for random velocity error
geometry.distance_sensitivity: Homologous rescaling of ALL lengths, including assumed vertical heights, preserves accelerations at corresponding angles and scales speeds as sqrt(D/D_nominal). This is a declared source-shape sensitivity, not full distance/source covariance.
geometry.inclination_sensitivity: Shift kinematic deprojection only by +/-3 degrees; source-footprint/inclination re-projection and warp uncertainty remain unresolved. No claim of full joint geometry propagation.

scoring.secondary: same residual with shared inclination rank-one covariance and with an extra 5 km/s diagonal stress floor, separately
scoring.single_object_removal: undefined because this pilot contains one object; report explicitly
scoring.raw_counterexample_unit: one galaxy versus RAR on matched source and geometry

unresolved: Source maps and gas velocities share measurements and are not statistically independent.
Missing outer stellar/CO data are not observations of zero material.
Warp, pressure support, noncircular streaming and exact detector response are not fitted or corrected here.
Alternate HI weighting/reduction, full inclination reprojection and joint source-response covariance are not propagated.
Fixed isolated boundary omits environmental external-field effects.
No galaxy population, held-out confirmation, direct outer-star velocity measurement or derived lensing test.
claim_ceiling: QUALITY_LIMITED_DEVELOPMENT_EVIDENCE_RETAINED; no formula-family pruning or empirical promotion
